entry.title: Early Learning Center Teachers
entry.content: Teachers are responsible for the overall management and instruction in the Early Learning Center. These positions plan and implement developmentally appropriate curriculum, ensure a safe and nurturing learning environment, maintain compliance with licensing and program standards, and build positive relationships with children and families.

entry.title: Director of Workforce Operations
entry.content: The Director of Workforce Operations provides operational leadership and oversight for workforce training programs within the Continuing Education and Training Department. This position is responsible for the administration, coordination, and continuous improvement of workforce programs, ensuring efficient operations, high-quality student experiences, regulatory compliance, accurate data management, and sustainable program delivery.

entry.title: Health Sciences Program Site Coordinator
entry.content:
The Great Falls College Health Science Program Site Coordinator supports the daily operations of
health science program at the Swingle Center on the Montana State University campus, including a
small dental hygiene clinic. This role ensures classes, labs, and the clinic function smoothly,
supports students and adjunct faculty, and serves as a liaison between the site and the main campus

entry.title: Lead Business Advisor, 10KSB Mountain West Region (INTERNAL ONLY)
entry.content: Business Advisors support designated groups of 5-7business owners as they complete the main 10KSB deliverables: a written growth plan and growth pitch.

entry.title: Adjunct Faculty Pool
entry.content: Great Falls College MSU has varying needs for adjunct instructors. Adjunct instructors are hired Semester to Semester based on the needs of the institution, in a variety of subject areas.

entry.title: Native American Studies Adjunct Instructor
entry.content:
Great Falls College MSU invites applications for an Adjunct Instructor in Native American Studies to teach courses on an as-needed basis. The current need is for 3–6 credits beginning fall 2026 or later, with instruction delivered on campus in a face-to-face format. Courses may be scheduled in a face-to-face or asynchronous online format to support both traditional and nontraditional students.
This position is a temporary, non-benefits eligible appointment. Employment is determined on a course-by-course basis.

entry.title: Dental Hygiene Program Adjunct (part-time) Faculty **Updated**
entry.content: This is a part-time clinical adjunct position in the Dental Hygiene Program. This position performs instruction-related duties and responsibilities for the Division of Health Sciences and the Dental Hygiene degree program in accordance with the philosophy, mission, policies and procedures of the college. Our students and faculty have access to a Dental Clinic located on campus.

entry.title: College Writing Adjunct Faculty Pool
entry.content: The GFC Writing & Languages Department maintains a pool of non-tenure-track applicants for consideration as potential instructors in writing courses. These instructors teach online asynchronous, hy-flex, blended, and/or face-to-face College Writing I courses as needed.

entry.title: Clinical Adjunct Instructor Nursing Pool
entry.content: This role offers a meaningful opportunity to mentor and guide future nurses through hands-on clinical education.
